description: Withdraw a pending invitation by email address. Requires an API key with the `people:invite` scope, held by an owner. An accepted invitation and an owner invitation cannot be withdrawn this way; another company's invitation reads as not found. Only call when the operator asked to withdraw it.

email.description: The address the invitation was sent to.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_withdraw_person_invitation
title: Withdraw person invitation
